_about: Bronislaw Malinowski (1884-1942), founder of fieldwork anthropology. Project Gutenberg: The Family among the Australian Aborigines (1913); Argonauts of the Western Pacific (1922), with Frazer's preface. Raw IA OCR: Crime and Custom in Savage Society (Harcourt, Brace; Kegan Paul, 1926); Myth in Primitive Psychology (New Science Series, copyright 1926; the verso year is the only one printed). Held: Sex and Repression in Savage Society (1927) and The Sexual Life of Savages (1929); the scans found are a 1937 impression and a later Harvest paperback. US public domain. No uids minted.
